notes: Exact 100-cell V1 IDs and positions retained by expanding east/south from same NW origin.
Native DEM is an interpolated surface, not 5m spot measurement coverage.
Terrain GLB is a local projected planar mesh, not a full Moon sphere.
Moon ME/DE421 lat/lon coordinate conversion does not automatically validate JPL Horizons topographic observer height.
GLB geometry uses Moon projected X/Y metres and absolute DEM elevations; glTF rendering defaults may use Y-up.
Standard GeoJSON tools may assign Earth EPSG4326; override with lunar CRS.
Parquet structural verification is not full independent reader interoperability.
